በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
እምዘርእከ: ዘርእ — from your seed (እም- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
አበዊከ: አብ — your fathers (noun, plural አበው + -ka '2ms your')
በምጽአቱ: ምጽአት — at his coming (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ተፈጥረት: ተፈጥረ — she was created (3fs perfect, passive of ፈጠረ; subject ታቦት) · 'it was brought about' with fem. subject ስሕተተ (ስሕተተ ተባዕት ተፈጥረት 'the error of the man came about')
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
ዕንቈ: ዕንቍ — jewel, precious stone (noun, construct 'stones of'; ዕንቈ ባሕርያተ 'pearl-stones')
እምቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, prior to · 'from before' (እምቅድመ ገጾሙ 'from before their faces')
ፈጠራ: ፈጠረ — he created her (3ms perfect, G, f-ṭ-r; + -ኣ 'her')
ለሔዋን: ሔዋን — Eve (proper name; ለ- naming the object after ረገማ)
ለአዳም: አዳም — of/for Adam · Adam as object, marked with ለ- (ሤሞ ለአዳም 'he appointed Adam')
ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ብዝኁ: በዝኀ — they were many, abundant (3mpl perfect, G; written ብዝኁ after ኮነ 'became'; a plural verb beside the singular ኮነ is unexplained, so reading uncertain)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
ወገብአት: ገብአ — she returned (3fs perfect, G, g-b-ʾ; ወ- 'and')
ከርሡ: ከርሥ — his belly, his body (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day')
ኮኑ: ኮነ — they became (3mp perfect, k-w-n) · 'so they were' in a simile (ከማሁ ኮኑ 'thus they were')
በኵረ: በኵር — firstborn (noun, accusative, in apposition to ደቂቅክሙ 'as firstborn')
በጽሐት: በጽሐ — she arrived, reached (3fs perfect, G)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
ወእምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ; ወ- 'and')
፬: ፬ — 4, spoken አርባዕቱ (ʾarbaʿtu) 'four'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'four' (ውስተ ፬ መሳምክቲሃ 'in her four supports'; spoken አርባዕ ʾarbaʿ before a feminine plural, አርባዕቱ with a masculine)
አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
፮: ፮ — 6, spoken ስድስቱ (sədstu) 'six'; chapter number (numeral) · count: ፮ ዓመተ 'six years', ፮ ሲሕ 'six thousand (?)'
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ወልቡናከ: ልቡና — and your understanding (ወ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
ሀገሩ: ሀገር — his city, 'the city of' (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለንጉሥ)
እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return')
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ርእዩ: ርእየ — see! (2mp imperative) · they saw (3mp perfect, ሶበ ርእዩ 'when they saw'; ch. 53)
ወበደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — and in the latter, last
ባሕቱ: ባሕቱ — but, however, nevertheless (conjunction; አላ ባሕቱ 'but nevertheless')
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?)
ትከውን: ኮነ — you will be (2ms imperfect) · also 3fs 'she/it becomes, is' (እንተ ትከውን ሲሳየ 'which is food')
ለእስራኤል: እስራኤል — to Israel, O Israel (ለ- + proper name) · over Israel (ይነግሥ ለእስራኤል 'he shall reign over Israel') · marking the object after ወአኅለፎሙ 'and he made them pass, Israel'
ይሰቅልዎ: ሰቀለ — they will crucify him (3mp imperfect, G, s-q-l, + -ኦ '3ms him')
ወሶበሰ: ሶበ — and if, and when (ወ- 'and' + conjunction + emphatic -ሰ)
ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n) · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ 'this is not a god'; ch. 13)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
ኀጢአት: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, fem.; here genitive after construct ርስሐተ 'defilement of sin')
ወይትነሣእ: ተንሥአ — and he rises (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ንሥአ)
ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
ይወርድ: ወረደ — it will descend (3ms imperfect, G, w-r-d)
ወይነሥት: ነሠተ — and he tears down, pulls down (ወ- + 3ms imperfect)
አረፋቲሃ: አረፍት — its walls (?) (plural አረፋት + -ሃ '3fs its'; sense uncertain) (?)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ዘይመጽእ: መጽአ — who comes (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
ወብእሲቱ: ብእሲት — and his wife (ወ- + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
